info.prompt: A high-tech reliquary where each die is displayed in its own bone-and-glass shrine, backlit by pulsating neural networks that branch across the obsidian walls—the central game board is a circular golden gate mechanism rotating slowly, its engraved alchemical symbols overlayed with holographic magenta hacker code, while above it floats a crown of jagged cyan crystals that emit a low hum, the entire composition framed by gothic rib-vaulting that dissolves into pixel static at the edges.
